en.headline: Lee says government will crack down on forced shopping in Golden Week
en.dek: Cross-department meetings, a Security Bureau incident centre and extra staff at popular sites are planned for the National Day holiday rush.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday that the government had made extensive preparations for the National Day Golden Week and would take action against tour groups that force visitors to shop.

Lee said the Chief Secretary and the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau would convene cross-department meetings with the trade, with a focus on control points. When the holiday begins, the Security Bureau will activate its emergency monitoring and support centre, and the Tourism Board will run an online Golden Week page with traffic, weather and attraction information.

Popular sites such as Ocean Park, Hong Kong Disneyland, the Hong Kong Palace Museum and Ngong Ping 360 would have waiting times and any extended hours published, he said. A trial booking system at Po Pin Chau had worked smoothly over a weekend, and the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department would add staff to help first-time users and keep order.

On forced shopping, Lee said the practice damaged Hong Kong's tourism reputation. Travel agents or guides who broke the rules could have their registration cancelled, and registered shops would be dealt with under the law. He also asked residents to welcome visitors courteously.

zh.headline: 李家超：國慶黃金周嚴打強迫購物 跨部門統籌口岸及景點
zh.dek: 特首指政務司司長及文體旅局將開跨部門會議，保安局黃金周會啟動緊急事故監察及支援中心，旅發局亦設網上專頁。
body: 行政長官李家超周二表示，特區政府已為國慶十一黃金周做大量準備，期望旅客有良好體驗並再訪香港，同時會打擊強迫購物。
他出席行政會議前說，政務司司長與文化體育及旅遊局會召開跨部門會議，統籌業界及各部門，特別針對口岸。黃金周開始時，保安局會啟動緊急事故監察及支援中心，加強發放交通、口岸及景點資訊，旅發局亦會在網上開設黃金周專頁。
李家超指海洋公園、迪士尼樂園、故宮文化博物館及昂坪360等受歡迎景點，會否延長開放、輪候時間及公共交通運作等消息都會發放。破邊洲預約制試行一個周末後運作暢順，預期黃金周人流更多，漁護署會加派人手協助首次使用系統的旅客及維持秩序。
他強調強迫購物損害香港旅遊聲譽，一定嚴打；旅行社或導遊若違規可被取消註冊，註冊商店亦會依法處理。他同時希望市民有禮接待旅客。
